headline: New housing provident fund policy adds further support; Shijiazhuang optimizes housing provident fund loan policy and opens renovation withdrawal service
summary: Shijiazhuang has optimised its housing provident fund loan policy and opened a service allowing withdrawals for home renovation. The measures add to a new national provident fund policy.
why: The housing provident fund is a compulsory savings scheme in China that funds mortgages for workers. Changes to its rules affect household housing demand and mortgage activity.
